grammar.q: Tony ____ to the party three days ago.
grammar.tip: Tony 是被邀請，過去時間 → was invited

grammar.q: The flowers ____ to a wrong address, so Mary didn't get them.
grammar.tip: 花是被寄送，過去 → were sent

grammar.q: Jo ____ to clean the house twice a week. She cleans it every Monday and Friday.
grammar.tip: Jo 被付錢請去打掃，現在習慣 → is paid

grammar.q: The knife ____ to cut meat. The cook uses it every day.
grammar.tip: 刀子被用來切肉 → be used to + V

grammar.q: The work must ____ by today, so we have to work overtime.
grammar.tip: 助動詞被動：must + be + p.p.

grammar.q: The picture was taken ____ a famous actress herself.
grammar.tip: 被動語態的動作者用 by

grammar.q: The question ____ many times.
grammar.tip: 完成式被動：have/has been + p.p.

grammar.q: You seldom spend money on clothes, ____?
grammar.tip: seldom 為否定詞 → 附加問句用肯定 do you

grammar.q: We have to get home before ten, ____?
grammar.tip: have to 是一般動詞 → don't we

grammar.q: There is nothing wrong, ____?
grammar.tip: nothing 為否定 → is there

grammar.q: She was sleeping when you got home, ____?
grammar.tip: 依主要子句 She was → wasn't she

grammar.q: Frank could hardly make a living, ____?
grammar.tip: hardly 為否定詞 → could he

grammar.q: The fan ____ broken yesterday. Luckily, Jacky fixed it this morning.
grammar.tip: yesterday 過去被動 → was broken

grammar.q: The ice cream should ____ in the fridge right away, or it will melt.
grammar.tip: should + be + p.p.（put 三態同形）

grammar.q: The cake ____ by Lisa tomorrow evening.
grammar.tip: 未來被動：will be + p.p.

grammar.q: This joke ____ by Michael many times at the party yesterday, but we still laughed out loud.
grammar.tip: yesterday + by → 過去被動 was told

grammar.q: The meeting ____ at 2 p.m. and lasted for three hours.
grammar.tip: 與 lasted 對等，過去式主動 started

grammar.q: Gary ____ me this book last week, and I will give it to my sister this weekend.
grammar.tip: Gary 主動寄書，last week → sent

grammar.q: Bill was sick yesterday. He didn't come to school, ____?
grammar.tip: 否定 didn't → 附加問句 did he

grammar.q: Jane ____ the news this morning. She felt surprised and angry.
grammar.tip: Jane 被告知消息 → was told

grammar.q:
A: Jennifer doesn't eat meat, does she?
B: ____, she ____. She's a vegetarian.
grammar.tip: 她不吃肉 → No, she doesn't.

grammar.q:
A: Aaron and Stacy are shy, ____?
B: Not really. They ____ not to talk to strangers.
grammar.tip: 肯定句配 aren't they；被告知 were told

grammar.q:
A: You don't have to worry about your kids, ____?
B: No, I don't. They are good kids.
grammar.tip: don't have to 否定 → do you

grammar.q:
A: The product ____ at every supermarket in Taiwan soon.
B: That's great.
grammar.tip: soon 未來 + 商品被賣 → will be sold

grammar.q: His grandmother gave Ted a red scarf on his last birthday, and it ____ by hand.
grammar.tip: 圍巾是被手工製作 → was made

grammar.q: Ted looked for his scarf, but it couldn't ____ anywhere.
grammar.tip: 圍巾被找到 → couldn't be found

grammar.q: We have to fix the wall, ____ we?
grammar.tip: have to 為一般動詞 → don't we

grammar.q: The strawberries ____ by the farmers tomorrow morning.
grammar.tip: 未來被動 → will be collected

grammar.q: I didn't call you because the phone ____ at that time.
grammar.tip: 當時電話正被使用 → was being used

grammar.q: A lot of rare animals can ____ in this national park.
grammar.tip: 動物被看見 → can be seen

grammar.q: Jane ____ she could never be a singer, but she made it.
grammar.tip: Jane 被告知 + that 子句（句意完整）

grammar.q: The delicious cookies ____ by Aunt Stella.
grammar.tip: 餅乾被做 → were made

grammar.q:
A: Tiffany won't come to the party tonight, ____?
B: No. She has to do a report today.
grammar.tip: won't 否定 → will she

grammar.q: The floor has to ____ every morning.
grammar.tip: has to + be + p.p.

grammar.q:
A: Sam has never tried an apple pie before, ____?
B: No, never.
grammar.tip: never 否定 + 完成式 → has he

grammar.q: Grace is a great writer. Her new book is sure to ____ by a lot of people.
grammar.tip: be sure to + be p.p.（書被喜愛）

grammar.q: The bad guy ____ yet. Be careful when you go out at night.
grammar.tip: 壞人尚未被抓 → hasn't been caught

grammar.q:
A: Your mother has never been to London, ____?
B: No, but she wants to take a trip there.
grammar.tip: never 否定 → 肯定附加問句 has she

grammar.q: This report ____ before next Friday because my teacher doesn't accept late homework.
grammar.tip: 報告被完成 → must be finished

grammar.q:
A: The old lady was ____ a strange man yesterday.
B: That was terrible! Did the police catch the man?
grammar.tip: 被某人殺 → was killed by + 人

grammar.q: KK Junior High School is an old school. It ____ built over 100 years ago.
grammar.tip: ago 過去式被動 → was built

grammar.q:
A: The actor is terrible, ____?
B: No, he's not. It is the story of the movie. It's terrible.
grammar.tip: 肯定 is → isn't he

grammar.q:
A: You have an English class today, ____?
B: Yes. It will begin at two this afternoon.
grammar.tip: have 當「有」為一般動詞 → don't you

grammar.q:
A: You haven't been to the new theater, ____?
B: No, but I will go there with Bill tomorrow.
grammar.tip: haven't 否定 → have you

grammar.q:
A: When will the car ____?
B: In an hour.
grammar.tip: 車被修 → will + be fixed

grammar.q: The park ____ beautiful flowers in spring. You should come and see them.
grammar.tip: be filled with 充滿…

grammar.q: Most of Jimmy's paintings ____ when he was young.
grammar.tip: 畫被賣，過去 → were sold

grammar.q: Don't use that knife to cut bread. It ____ cut meat.
grammar.tip: be used to + V 被用來…

grammar.q: Ed ____ in the accident. He ____ his leg and was taken to the hospital.
grammar.tip: 人受傷 got hurt；傷到腿 hurt his leg

grammar.q: There will be a new metro station near here, ____?
grammar.tip: There will be → won't there

grammar.q: Rita's read the book before, ____?
grammar.tip: Rita's read = has read

fix.t: My dog Jimmy [[loves]] [[brushing]] with a comb. Every time I comb his hair, he [[will close]] his eyes and fall asleep.
fix.tip: 狗是「被」梳毛 → love being brushed（動名詞被動）

fix.t: David [[looked out of]] the balcony window and [[saw]] a woman get in his car [[and drove]] away.
fix.tip: saw + 受詞 + 原形；and 連接 get in 與 drive

fix.t: It was very windy this morning. Some of the shirts on the balcony [[were blown]] away [[and fallen]] [[in]] the pond.
fix.tip: fallen 是 p.p. 不能當動詞；and 連接 fell

fix.t: Alison doesn't like [[to tell]] what [[to do]]. She only [[does]] things she wants to do.
fix.tip: Alison 是「被」告知 → like to be told（不定詞被動）

fix.t: The housework in Mr. and Mrs. Wang's family [[are shared]] [[between]] them and their kids. [[Everyone's got]] their own job to do.
fix.tip: 主詞 the housework 不可數、單數 → is shared

fix.t: [[Having]] three cups of coffee a day [[can't be]] bad for our health, [[can they]]?
fix.tip: 動名詞片語當主詞視為單數，附加問句用 it → can it

fix.t: [[Getting up]] early on a cold morning [[is not]] easy, [[does it]]?
fix.tip: 動詞是 is not → 附加問句用 be 動詞：is it

fix.t: Doraemon, a blue Japanese robot cat, [[has hated]] mice since his ears [[have bitten]] [[by]] a mouse.
fix.tip: 耳朵「被」咬，且是過去的事 → were bitten

fix.t: Many famous people [[visit]] this restaurant. Popular singers like A-mei and Jay Chou [[often seen]] here [[with]] their friends.
fix.tip: 句子缺動詞，歌手「被看見」→ are often seen

fix.t: Don't worry. All the dishes [[have washed]], and the kitchen [[has been]] cleaned [[by]] Dad.
fix.tip: 碗盤是「被」洗，複數 → have been washed

fix.t: The new library [[will build]] next year, so the old one [[is going to be]] closed [[in]] March.
fix.tip: 圖書館是「被」建造，未來被動 → will be built

fix.t: Your phone must [[be turn]] off [[before]] the test [[begins]].
fix.tip: 助動詞被動：must + be + p.p. → be turned

fix.t: Each of the students [[was given]] a book, and the books [[was]] [[written]] by Mr. Lin.
fix.tip: 主詞 the books 為複數 → were written

fix.t: The accident [[was happened]] [[on]] a rainy night, and two people [[were hurt]].
fix.tip: happen 是不及物動詞，沒有被動 → happened

fix.t: My bike [[was stolen]] last week, so I [[am taken]] the bus to school [[these days]].
fix.tip: 是我主動搭公車 → am taking（主動進行式）

fix.t: This song [[was written]] by [[she]] when she [[was]] only sixteen.
fix.tip: 介系詞 by 後接受格 → by her

fix.t: Stars [[can't see]] in the city at night [[because]] the lights [[are]] too bright.
fix.tip: 星星是「被看見」→ can't be seen

fix.t: Your brother [[has never]] [[been to]] Japan, [[hasn't he]]?
fix.tip: never 是否定詞 → 附加問句用肯定 has he

fix.t: There [[is]] little milk [[in]] the fridge, [[isn't there]]?
fix.tip: little 表否定 → 附加問句用肯定 is there

fix.t:
A: Nobody [[was]] late for the meeting, [[wasn't he]]?
B: No. Everyone [[came]] on time.
fix.tip: nobody 為否定 → 肯定問句；代名詞用 they → were they

fix.t: [[It's]] a sunny day. [[Let's]] go hiking, [[will you]]?
fix.tip: Let's 表提議 → 附加問句用 shall we

fix.t: [[Please]] turn down the music, [[don't you]]? I [[am trying]] to study.
fix.tip: 祈使句的附加問句一律用 will you

fix.t:
A: There are a lot of people in the park, [[aren't they]]?
B: Yes. There [[is]] a concert [[there]] tonight.
fix.tip: There are … 的附加問句保留 there → aren't there

fix.t: [[I think]] Ken [[is]] the best player on the team, [[don't I]]?
fix.tip: I think + 子句：附加問句依子句 Ken is → isn't he

fix.t:
A: [[Everyone]] [[is]] here now, [[isn't it]]?
B: Yes. Let's start the meeting.
fix.tip: everyone 的附加問句代名詞用 they → aren't they

fix.t:
A: Mike [[don't]] drink coffee, [[does]] he?
B: [[No]], he doesn't. He only drinks tea.
fix.tip: 主詞 Mike 第三人稱單數 → doesn't drink
